subject.title: feat(mcp): add openclaw mcp call for one configured tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose a supported core CLI contract for directly executing one configured MCP tool, rather than keeping configured MCP execution limited to agent runs and external MCP clients?
rationale: This is a new operator capability and public command contract, not a repair to an established broken behavior; code review cannot determine whether the additional execution surface is desired product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow CLI command
options.body: Keep the command in the existing MCP CLI after fixing lifecycle cleanup and adding real configured-server proof.

options.title: Keep execution agent-only
options.body: Decline the new command surface and retain the existing status, doctor, and probe diagnostics as the supported CLI workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow CLI command
recommendation.body: Keep the command in the existing MCP CLI after fixing lifecycle cleanup and adding real configured-server proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence candidate to decide whether this generic MCP execution capability belongs in the core CLI.
